_comment: What the wiki was last checked against, and which source files each page's claims come from.
The full maintenance runbook is docs/wiki.md. This file is the machine-readable half of it.
This exists so that 'the wiki needs updating' is an answerable question rather than a re-read
of the whole game. `npm run wiki:check` fetches upstream, diffs these two commits against the
current tips of main and beta, and maps the changed files onto the pages that cite them — so
you get a list of pages to review rather than a list of commits to interpret.
WHEN YOU UPDATE THE WIKI: re-run the check, fix what it flags, then move `verifiedAgainst`
forward to the commits you actually verified against. Leaving it stale is worse than useless,
because the next person will trust it.
`sources` is deliberately coarse. A page lists the files whose behaviour it describes, not
every file it touches — the goal is 'this page probably needs a look', not a build graph.

verifiedAgainst.note: Every page and the site's own pages re-read against the code of both builds, a month after the last pass. Main had gained the real-world Modern Day map, one-request time skips, groups, projections, the flat interface, chunked desktop updates and the update screen at launch, the privacy policy and counting consent, CC BY 4.0 scenarios and the full Android app; beta had gained battlefields and the War Room, war at sea, alliances that call allies in, war weariness and peace on terms, manpower and funding, the country panel and ranking, seasons and weather, the diplomatic map mode, institutions, Listen in, multiplayer lobbies, the music, the vault door and update notices, Espionage Part 2 (orders, operations, unidentified captures, the new clarity curve), the Agent connection and the map editor's rework. The stable/beta split was redrawn page by page; two beta pages were added (war-room, war-at-sea). Written from source; no campaign was played through turns and no screenshot was taken.

Content screenshots (events, diplomacy, advisor, stats, espionage, retry) predate the 2026-09-24 pass and use the older palette.
Neither build was verified by playing a campaign through turns; the 2026-09-24 pass read source and drove main's menus and panels.

No screenshot of any surface added since 2026-09-24: the War Room, fleets and sea battles, the Intelligence tab's Operations, peace and call-to-arms cards, institutions, Listen in, the country panel and ranking, the vault door and update notices, the map editor's sidebar. pageVerified._comment: Pages re-verified against a commit NEWER than verifiedAgainst. wiki:check skips a page for a channel whose recorded commit here is at or past the current tip. Only add a page you actually re-read. Emptied on 2026-09-11, when the global record moved past every entry that was here.
